## Flagship Products & Engineering Systems

### 1. Trelio — Authorization-Before-Execution SaaS
- **URL**: https://trelio.in
- **Type**: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS
- **Architecture & Workflow**:
  - Eliminates unpaid scope creep and free work for freelancers and agencies.
  - Implements an **Authorization-Before-Execution (ABE)** lifecycle: work is partitioned into defined milestones. Clients must review and authorize each milestone with direct payment settlement before subsequent work execution unlocks.
  - Zero intermediary funds holding / zero escrow risk: direct settlement to developer merchant accounts.
  - Features: AES-256-GCM encrypted deliverables, SHA-256 tamper-evident milestone ledgers, HMAC webhook verification, and Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS).
- **Stack**: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Supabase RLS, Razorpay / UPI Direct Settlement.

### 2. Apex Packaging & Converting — Industrial B2B CPQ Platform
- **URL**: https://industrial-packaging-platform.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Chanakya2006gt/Industrial-packaging-platform
- **Type**: Cloud-Native Industrial CPQ & Estimating System
- **Architecture & Features**:
  - European **FINAT 1–8** automated rewind standard visualizer with precision winding orientation calculations.
  - **Isomorphic CPQ Engine**: deterministic linear-meter and surface-area pricing math running with 100% parity across client and server test suites.
  - Sales CRM operational decision gates with 4-hour SLA monitors and offline wire clearance.
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase RLS, GSAP, Isomorphic Math CPQ.
